selection: One message per context-disjoint TEST convai2 human free-worker conversation; old diagnostic80 conversations added to existing exclusions. No formula oversampling.
sampling_limit: Existing primary-attested concepts were authored before this selection, but known earlier family/scope caveats are reflected in the frozen research policy. Repeated surfaces are not called novel.
parent_acceptance: Root approved pre-output amendment to79 distinct unseen conversations,26/27/26 bins, deterministic feasible assignment and unchanged candidate/matcher. This is the one planned fresh comparison; do not reuse contexts to manufacture80.
assignment: Deterministic bipartite matching of length-bin slots to disjoint conversations, using fixed hash ordering; minimum-hash message per conversation/bin. No semantic/target-output choice. All79 remaining eligible conversations used once.
corpus_exhaustion: After this sample no unseen convai2 TEST conversations remain under these criteria. Treat all subsequent reuse as diagnostic.
